metadata.title: Multiplicity Theory: A Prime-Weighted Braid Invariant from Prime Distributions
metadata.description:
Multiplicity Theory introduces P(K), a prime-weighted braid invariant for constitutional lattice protection. Version 2.1 corrects the categorical framing from v2.0 following Lessard audit (April 2026).

The invariant is constructed via conjugation of the standard U_q(sl₂) R-matrix by prime-indexed operators O_p, yielding a Yang-Baxter-preserving but category-changing construction. The healing-rate coupling c₀ = ln(10) emerges from self-consistency on prime-harmonic couplings (ADR-106); z = 1/(2cos1) from prime-distribution averages (ADR-109).

Key findings:
- YBE preserved (residual < 10⁻¹⁵)
- Representation category: PROJECTIVE (not Rep(U_q(sl₂)))
- Modified Markov trace required for invariance
- 7 knots validated: trefoil, figure-eight, cinquefoil, torus T(2,n)

The protection mechanism in HELIX-CORE depends on GapLB > 0 and is independent of the knot category.
